## InputPilot 1.1.0
**After updating, the welcome window appears once** so you can turn on *Open InputPilot at login*. Without it, InputPilot stops working after a restart.
### New - **Layouts you pick yourself are kept.** Switch with ⌃Space, the input menu or Undo, and InputPilot keeps your choice until you type on another keyboard. Settings → Switching offers alternatives, including the old behaviour. - **Open at login**, in the welcome window and in Settings. - **"Use … for …"** in the menu maps the keyboard you are typing on to the current input source in one click. - **Relaunch InputPilot** finishes setup after you grant Input Monitoring.
### Fixed - Two USB keyboards of the same model, on different ports, now each get their own mapping. - Karabiner-Elements holding a keyboard no longer stops keyboard detection outright. - Emoji & Symbols and Dictation are no longer offered as mapping targets. - Settings and other windows now open in front of the active app. - A lone F6 press now counts as typing.
Full details: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/LucaGerlich/InputPilot/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
